Rewinding Raindrops is the fifth act in Chapter I of the Main Quests.

Contents

  • 1 Steps
  • 2 Gameplay Notes
  • 3 Dialogue
  • 4 Other Languages
  • 5 Change History
  • 6 Navigation

Steps[]

  1. Meet up with Yangyang and Chixia
  2. Find Linsu
  3. Go to the waterfall behind the square
  4. Go through the waterfall
  5. Follow the flowers
  6. Talk to Yangyang
  7. Locate where the sound is coming from
  8. Defeat the Fractsidus members (0/2)
  9. Find a suitable place to lure out your stalker
  10. Meet up with Yangyang
  11. Look for Aalto
  12. Catch Aalto
  13. Talk to Aalto and Encore
  14. Go to the Court of Savantae Facility
  15. Fight off the Tacet Discords (0/3)
  16. Go to the Court of Savantae Facility
  17. Find a way to turn on electricity
  18. Search the room for clues (0/2)
  19. Find a way to turn on electricity
  20. Fight off the Tacet Discords (0/4)
  21. Activate the device on the wall
  22. Take the elevator to the basement
  23. Defeat the enemy
  24. Meet Aalto at the entrance

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing step "Catch Aalto" will award the player Union EXP ×600, Shell Credit ×20,000, Peculiar Blake Bloom, Advanced Resonance Potion ×2, and Advanced Energy Core ×2.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".
Yangyang: ...I see.
Yangyang: Yes... I can feel the tension in the Streams.
Yangyang: I'm worried something bad is going to happen...
Chixia: There you are, Rover!
Sorry for keeping you waiting.
Did something happen?
Baizhi: The Academy has noted a concerning rise of Tacet Field activities. Please use caution when exiting the city.
Thanks for the warning.
How's your research going?
Baizhi: Remember to check your Terminal signals, and wear the Academy's protective suit correctly.
Baizhi: ...And don't forget to stay hydrated. Now, I have experiments to run. Take care.
Was that a voicemail message...
Is she sending the same thing to everyone...
Chixia: It's just Baizhi being Baizhi. She's a little awkward with showing care, but I think it's cute!
Chixia: Anyway! Rover, quick, tell us what happened!
After a brief moment of thinking, you gave them a brief run down of your meeting with Jinhsi, but didn't mention Jué's disappearance...
Chixia: The Fractsidus again? Ugh, those jerks!
About Jiyan...
Rover: Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou's Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?
Chixia: Connection? ...No idea, but I did hear General Jiyan used to be a military doctor...
Yangyang: Hmm... Speaking of that, I think we'll need to start with a bit of Jinzhou's past.
Yangyang: A storyteller near the theater once told us something like this...
(Cutscene plays)
Narrator: The honorable Madam Jinhsi, our great magistrate of Jinzhou, was handpicked by Sentinel Jué. Her status as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator is rare among all past magistrates.
Narrator: Our Jinzhou was leaderless for years until Jué finally chose her to be the next Magistrate, and she answered the call.
Narrator: To further elaborate, we must start with the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".
Narrator: The Norfall Barrens, scarred by countless wars... Discarded weapons scattered like bones.
Narrator: Our soldiers had fought to reclaim the lands for years, to no avail.
Narrator: Ovathrax, the dreadful Threnodian monster, fed on the frequencies of "weapons" turning our fallen soldiers into deadly Tacet Discords...
Narrator: General of the Midnight Rangers, Geshu Lin, bravely rose to confront the threat.
Narrator: As twin moons aligned, General Geshu Lin vowed to vanquish evil, raising his blade against the blood-red crescent that foretold destruction.
Narrator: His sword blazed with black flames, laying waste to all who dared stand in his way. Victory seemed certain...
Narrator: ...Until the Retroact Rain began to fall.
Narrator: Raindrops fell upwards as in the past. Monsters raged, loyal souls fell to blood-soaked sands... Infernal carnage!
Narrator: Issuing his last command, Geshu Lin demanded all soldiers stand firm, no matter what happened.
Narrator: Sacrificing his body to the black flames for power, Geshu Lin charged at the Overthrax with all his might... And he was never seen again.
Narrator: After the fall of their leader, the remaining soldiers despaired... Until a deafening roar of the QingloongTeal Dragon struck like lightning. A lone youth bravely stood up to lead. A hard-won retreat!
Narrator: After the battle, that young man who tamed the wind ascended to fame, becoming the new General of Midnight Rangers, selected by Sentinel Jué.
Narrator: On the other hand, General Geshu was blamed for massive losses that occurred under his command, earning him a notorious reputation in Huanglong...
Narrator: That battle struck us hard, but our Sentinel rose from its long slumber to select a new Magistrate who guide us into the future.
Narrator: Despite the previous disaster, Jinzhou was off to a promising start under our Sentinel and the new Magistrate's guidance. The people held hope for a better tomorrow.
(Cutscene ends)
Chixia: Woah. First time hearing about all that...
Why did Jué choose Jinhsi to be Magistrate?
Chixia: Uhhh... Maybe the Sentinel had its own special ways of picking candidates?
Yangyang: Or maybe it is their incomprehensible ways that set these divine beings apart from us? Their thinking tends to be elusive to the average person.
Chixia: Yeah, true. Wouldn't be surprised if Jué decided to make me the Magistrate one day, not gonna lie!
Does it ever ask the opinion of the person selected?
Yangyang: I understand your concern, Rover.
Yangyang: Madam Jinhsi was only a teenager, and she was suddenly selected to be the Magistrate. It must have been so difficult for her...
Yangyang: I remember people were skeptical when she first took office.
Yangyang: Despite her achievements, many believed she lacked the necessary experience and authority in the political realm.
Yangyang: People only showed their respect to Madam Jinhsi because they trusted Jué's judgement.
Chixia: Seriously, Lord Jué knows how to choose 'em. Our previous Magistrates were all top-notch at running the show.
Chixia: And Madam Jinhsi? She's already made this city a well-oiled machine in no time.
Chixia: I'd have a mental Overclock just trying to keep up with all that paperwork... She was made for this!
Chixia: Uh, what is that saying again? Real gold never loses its shine!
Yangyang: Rover, since you are asking about this... Did you get clues about your past from Jinhsi?
Jué asked me to find Jiyan in the Norfall Barrens at a specific time.
Chixia: The Norfall Barrens?! It's been a battlefield since ancient times...
Yangyang: Rover, it's dangerous there. The Norfall Barrens is the frontline in our defense against the Threnodian. We must be careful about going there.
There's another "Overseer" of the Fractsidus lurking in Jinzhou.
Yangyang: They sent two Overseers at once... Their scheme must be far more expansive than we thought.
Yangyang: Though the Fractsidus do seem to know a lot about you... Their ideology and actions are too dangerous.
Yangyang: And right now, the odds are in their favor. if we rush into a confrontation, it could lead us into their traps.
An organization called the Black Shores has been watching me.
Chixia: The Black Shores? Doesn't ring a bell... Sounds like a name of a place, but I've never seen it on any map.
Yangyang: This flower... It's only a photo, and I can't tell where it came from with my ability.
The Black Shores is an organization that studies the Lament.
Every Black Shores member wears a flower like this.
Yangyang: Hmm... We're still in the dark about Fractsidus' plans, and the Norfall Barrens is too risky. The Black Shores seems to be our only option now.
Yangyang: But if we are to look for them with only a photo of this flower... It's going to be difficult.
Chixia: Since it's about flowers... We should go ask Grandma Lin!
Yangyang: Yes! Grandma Lin runs a flower shop. I'm sure she can give us some tips.
Chixia: Hehe... You're making me blush a litte.
Chixia: Grandma Lin loves listening to storytellers. I think I saw her earlier... Let's go look for her.
(Optional - Talk to Storyteller)
Storyteller: There is still some time before the next session. Here are some book to keep you entertained before that, dear listeners.
(Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Storyteller: So you want to learn more about that battle?
Storyteller: They say that storytelling inevitably carries some subjective bias, all to enhance the ebb and flow of the narrative.
Storyteller: But when it comes to the "Battle Beneath the Crescent," we typically avoid adding any of our personal commentary, focusing instead on accurately retelling history.
Storyteller: But even just telling the story carries a heavy emotional weight.
Storyteller: Was Geshu Lin truly an unforgivable sinner? Was General Jiyan the perfect hero?
Storyteller: The sudden onset of the Retroact Rain, the decision of our Sentinel, and the timing behind this series of events...
Storyteller: I guess it will be up to future generations to figure it all out, haha.
(Optional - Talk to Elder Listener)
Elder Listener: Tough break... It's just plain bad luck.
(Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Elder Listener: So you want to learn more about that battle? Not many youngsters care these days! I'm happy to talk about it with you!
Elder Listener: People blamed Geshu Lin for his decision to push for an attack during the Retroact Rain.
Elder Listener: But he's ultimately jut [sic] a human like the rest of us. Him having a powerful Resonance Ability doesn't change that.
Elder Listener: Fate can be a funny thing... Nobody could've predicted that weird rain happening.
Elder Listener: If our soldiers hadn't held onto the defense lines in the Norfall Barrens to the last minute, Jinzhou might have fallen too.
Elder Listener: Anyone, even someone like me, would've probably given a similar order in that situation.
Elder Listener: So I don't think Geshu Lin should be painted as an unforgivable criminal.
Elder Listener: General Jiyan is a capable leader no doubt, but let's be real, he only rose to fame for showing up at the right time.
Elder Listener: Sigh, that's just how fate works sometimes...
(Optional - Talk to Middle-aged Listener)
Middle-aged Listener: Maybe he's got his own personality to blame...
(Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Middle-aged Listener: Oh? You want my take on it?
Middle-aged Listener: I'm not very familiar with the history, but I did hear some rumours about General Geshu Lin.
Middle-aged Listener: Compared to all the past Midnight Rangers Generals, Geshu Lin wasn't that big on commanding his troops from behind. He preferred being right there on the battlefield, leading the charge.
Middle-aged Listener: To achieve his strategic goal, he didn't even hesitate about sending people to their deaths...
Middle-aged Listener: ... Makes sense that he'd refuse to let his troops retreat.
Middle-aged Listener: People said the troops he commanded were disciplined, but I guess the soldiers obeyed him more out of fear than respect.
Middle-aged Listener: So, I think you can pretty much have an idea about General Geshu Lin's personality.
Middle-aged Listener: Honestly, I think he deserved it. The moment he lost his soldiers' support, his failure was pretty much unavoidable.
Middle-aged Listener: And considering the heavy losses he caused... Yeah, he should be called a criminal.
(Optional - Talk to Young Listener)
Young Listener: Is it a coincidence? Is it fate? Nah, no...
(Ask him [sic] about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Young Listener: Oh oops, are you talking to me? My bad, I was lost in my thoughts.
Young Listener: I'm a student at Jinzhou Imperial Academy studying history, and I'm especially intrigued by everything related to the Sentinel.
Young Listener: The Sentinel plays a crucial role in Jinzhou's history. But here's something interesting, I'm not sure you've noticed...
Young Listener: In our local folklore and tales, the Sentinel is always portrayed as an omnipotent being that transcends human understanding.
Young Listener: But I believe there must be a pattern in its thought process. The people chosen to become Magistrates must share some similar traits.
Young Listener: So, I wonder: what criteria does the Sentinel use to select future leaders?
Young Listener: We were all confident and determined to defeat the ThrenodianOvathrax before. But after that crushing defeat, everyone's confidence took a hit.
Young Listener: We still wanted to win, to eliminate that dreadful monster once and for all, but... we became more cautious.
Young Listener: Interestingly, the newly appointed General and Magistrate both seem to be the calm and cautious type.
Young Listener: Perhaps the Sentinel chooses our leaders based on the public consensus at the time.
Young Listener: But hey, that's just me thinking out loud. I'm all ears to your opinions. Your take might just open my eyes!
(Talk to Linsu)
Linsu: Oh, hello! Chixia, Yangyang, what brought you here?
Chixia: Hey, Grandma Lin! We're here for some stories today, and here's our new friend!
Chixia: Ta-da! We've got the ultimate badass here! The one who can crush TDs, cook up Echos, knock Inferno Rider flat, and KO Feilian Beringal with a single punch! The legendary Rover!
Hello.
Linsu: Haha, so you're the famous Rover! Oh, youngsters these days are really something.
No, I didn't...Please don't listen to her...
Linsu: Haha, that's just Chixia talks. Please don't mind her.
This lady looks too young to be called a Grandma.
Linsu: Oh my, you're such a sweetheart!
Chixia: Grandma Lin, since you're the flower expert, I've got a favor to ask.
(Show her the Blake Bloom picture.)
Yangyang: Have you seen flowers like this one before?
Linsu: Hmm... I'm familiar with most of the flowers local to Jinzhou, but this one... it doesn't match anything we have here.
Linsu: I don't think I've seen anything similar, not even in the plant encyclopedias...
Chixia: Oh no... If not even a flower expert like you can recognize it, who else could help us?
Linsu: Oh, Chixia, I'm far from an expert. We've got a plant-type Resonator here in Jinzhou, remember? She knows the plants much better than me.
Yangyang: Oh, are you talking about that young lady? I always see her helping out at your store.
Linsu: Yes, she has been a great help. She knows a lot about everything plant related.
Linsu: And she is such a sweet child. Her smiles always make me happy. She reminds me of the lovely Starflowers.
Linsu: I'd call out to her: Lil Starflower, it's dinner time! And she'd always answer with her brightest smile. What a lovely girl.
Where can we find her?
Do you have her number?
Linsu: My apologies, but I don't remember... I'm to old to work these fancy stuff...
That's a cute nickname.
Linsu: Oh, how I wish she was my granddaughter...
Linsu: She's probably up in the back mountain doing some field research.
Linsu: I said I wanted a field in the back mountain and she offered to help right away. That's where she is now, checking it out.
Linsu: Go in that direction, and soon you'll see a waterfall. Walk right through the waterfall, then you'll reach the back mountain.
Yangyang: Thank you so much, Grandma Lin.
Linsu: Oh, anytime, dearie! Don't forget to visit my Penjing shop. I'll have treats ready for you!
(As player approaches the waterfall)
Yangyang: This should be the shortcut to the back mountain. Once we cross the waterfall, we'll reach Mt. Pingting.
(After player goes through the waterfall)
Yangyang: The flowers seem to be showing us the way. Let's follow it.
(As player follows the flower trail)
Yangyang: A bridge of flowers... That's impressive...
(Cutscene plays) (Cutscene ends)
Verina: Hello... Are you lost? Do you need help?
Are you Verina?
Lil Starflower?
Verina: ...Starflower? That's what Grandma Lin likes to call me...
Verina: Oops, sorry! I should've introduced myself first... I know it's polite thing to do in Huanglong...
Verina: It is... It is a delight to make your acquaintance. I am Verina. My "pressure" to have the opportunity to meet with you today...
It's "pleasure".
Verina: My apologies. I used to live in the New Federation, so I'm not very familiar with the language here.
No need for formalities.
Verina: My apologies. I used to live in the New Federation, so I'm not very familiar with the etiquette here.
What if we were some bad guys? Aren't you worried?
Verina: Eh? Really But that flower next to you said she likes you a lot...
Verina: Plants don't lie. I trust their words, so you can't be bad guys.
Chixia: Hi, Verina! I'm Chixa, this is Yangyang, and he/she's Rover! Grandma Lin told us we should come find you!
Verina: Oh, right. Grandma Lin talked about you. I left those flowers so she knows how to reach me.
Verina: What seems to be the trouble? If there's anything I can help you with...
Yangyang: We're looking for a special flower...
(Show her the picture.)
Verina: Hmm... It's an unusual flower indeed. Pure black flowers are rarely found in nature. We can't rule out the possibility that it's been dyed.
Verina: When looking at the structure, there are a few types of flowers that seem similar.
Verina: Take Iris, for example. Its petals are similarly oval-shaped, but it has double petals.
Verina: It's not Viola, either, since Viola has notched petals.
Verina: Then there's also the Cliffrecluse, but this flower has a longer stamen an extra petal.
Verina: Lemongrass is also similar in shape. It's native to the New Federation, and Huanglong people may not be familiar with it.
Verina: Though it has a similar stamen length, it has a conical inflorescence with a trumpet-shaped corolla.
Verina: Oh, and I almost forgot the Pecok Flower! It's a single-petaled flower with a similar stamen length!
Verina: But... The Pecok Flower has a distinct peduncle, while this one doesn't.
Chixia: Wow, you really know your stuff! I learned a lot from that!
Verina: Anyway, this black flower does look very special. There are hardly any similar plants in nature.
Verina: So, I'm thinking it might be a newly cultivated species.
Verina: Also, its veins are somehow cross-shaped... I can feel some faint traces of frequency fluctuations on it too. It's a sign of overflowing Remnant Energy.
Verina: So, my guess is it should be an unique Remnant plant, created by a certain type of Resonance Energy.
Verina: But in order to figure out the right soil for it, or exactly what type of Resonance Energy it is, I need more than just a picture.
Chixia: Gosh, help us out, someone! We don't know what kind of flower it is, and we haven't seen anyone wearing it either...
Chixia: Speaking of that... How does it even work? If I wore this flower on me right now, do I automatically become one of them?
Yangyang: Chixia, wait, what did you just say?
Chixia: Uhhh... Yeah? I was just saying if I worse this flower, would they immediately see me as one of their own...
Yangyang: If this black flower is indeed their symbol, the Black Shores members should immediately notice it on you.
Yangyang: But to all the other people, it would only look like a peculiar flower.
Yangyang: Given that... if they are indeed in Jinzhou city, we may only need to wear this flower to lure them out...
Chixia: Ohh, I see... but how do we get our hands on one?
Verina: Erm, I... I could probably make one for you with my Resonance Ability... if you just need something that looks similar...
Verina: Come on, Verina, you can do it...
Chixia: No way? That's amazing, seriously! It looks exactly like the flower in that picture!
Verina: T-thank you, it's nothing... I'm glad I could help.
Chixia: It's friggin amazing! Could you do that again? Please! I love it!
(Optional - Talk to Chixia or Verina)
Chixia: Rover, did you see that? Miss Verina just conjured up this exquisite Blake Bloom out of thin air!
Chixia: And! It looks exactly like the one in the photo!
Verina: Erm, it's just my Resonance Ability...
Chixia: Could you please make another one? Then there'll be one for each of us!
Verina: Sure, I-I'll give it another try...
(Talk to Yangyang)
Yangyang: Rover, have you noticed?
Yangyang: We've been seeing these black petals for a while now... They're scattered all over the place, I'm sure they're not made by Miss Verina.
Yangyang: The Streams have been disrupted... Someone has been following us.
Leave it to me.
You two should head back to the city.
Yangyang: Rover... Are you sure you want us to leave? It could be dangerous for you...
Trust me.
Yangyang: ...Okay. Chixia and I will wear these black flowers and go look for members of the Black Shores in the city.
Yangyang: Rover, please be careful. Ring us anytime when you need help.
(Investigate)
Black Petal: (The black petals scattered on the ground exude a faint ominous aura. You seem to have seen them on your way here...)
(Optional - Talk to Yangyang or Verina)
Chixia: Oh, I see! And guess what? Miss Verina just made another Blake Bloom for us. Now it comes in handy!
Chixia: Easy peasy! I've got this!
Yangyang Miss Verina, we should get you home now.
Yes, it's dangerous out in the wild lately.
It's dinner time. Grandma Lin is waiting for you.
Verina: Oh? Ah, sure. One moment, please...
(As player approaches the enemy)
Rover: (The Fractsidus? What are they doing in a place like this?)
Fractsidus Member: Damn that women! Always getting in our way... And what are you doing here? Get lost!
Rover: (...I'll have to take them down first.)
(After defeating the Fractsidus Members)
Rover: (The weird noises persist. They're coming after me.)
Rover: (If I climb up to that point, I should be able to get behind that person.)
(After climbing up to the spot)
Rover: (Better hide here for now.)
(Cutscene plays)
Mysterious Redhead: Hmm... Where is he/she hiding?
Rover: Looking for me?
Mysterious Redhead: Ohh, here you are.
(Cutscene ends)
??: You're such a box full of surprises.
Who are you?
Why are you following me?
??: So we're playing truth or dare now? I see... Oops!
??: Hehe... getting angry, are we? Sorry, but it's just so much fun to rile you up.
??: You're the very first person to pique my interest like this. You... have great potential.
Answer my question.
??: Okay, so you're not up for small talk. I'll keep that in mind. You're my mission target, after all.
Are you from the Black Shores?
??: Bingo! I'm one of the Bloom Bearers of the Black Shores.
??: This Blake Bloom is our symbol. It represents our mission to save the world.
??: That's what it says in the rules, at least.
What are you planning to do with me?
??: Our plans? Hmm... What is it again? To recruit as many talents as we can, and save the world from its impending doom.
??: So, are you in?
You don't sound like you want to save the world.
??: Nuh-uh, I don't! The world? Couldn't care less. If it's all going BOOM tomorrow, why not have fun while we can?
??: To stop at nothing for more power, take down any prey without mercy, and indulge in all our desires for the ultimate pleasure...
How are you any different from the Fractsidus then...
??: Well... I mean, I'd love to live that way, but alas, duty calls.
??: Our "Garden"The Black Shores is home to many green fruits, and we'll make you the most special "Seed" among them all...
??: My duty is to nurture and safeguard seeds like you, allowing them to blossom into luscious fruits.
??: Then once the fruit ripens, I'll get to pick it, and indulge the sweetness of my labor all by myself.
A fruit?
??: You're just like what TethysCivilization Simulation Sand Table has told us... I can feel such explosive potential within you. One day, you'll surely bear the most beautiful fruit imaginable.
That's none of my business.
??: Hehe... I like how cold you sound. You're tempting me to push your buttons a bit more...
??: Relax, relax. I'll behave for the time being.
??: No need to be so on edge. I won't do anything... strange, to you, I think?
??: Actually, I've been diligently protecting you, you know? I got rid of all types of pests that tried to get in your way!
??: Ew, don't mention me and the Fractsidus in the same sentence. I couldn't care less about their petty games, but if they even think of laying their dirty fingers on you... Hmph. You're mine, and I don't like sharing.
??: Just a couple tricks and I had those fools flapping around like headless chickens. What a boring crowd.
...Tricks?
Those fools?
??: Woah, don't tell me you haven't noticed?
??: Enjoyed your nightly rendezvous with that Loong Maiden? You have me to thank for keeping those Fractsidus people away.
??: Well... I've answered plenty of questions already. Now it's your turn.
What do you want to ask?
??: Hehe, nothing in particular.
??: The way you look at me though, it's almost as if... No forget about it.
Is this how you treat the talents you're trying to recruit?
??: ...
We've been in this position for long enough now.
??: ...Cough... Do you think I'd entertain... your inquires, if I didn't have a blade on my throat?...
??: Anyway, I'm not trying to get any answers from you...
??: But I'll be watching you. You're a very special "Seed", that I am very sure.
??: I can feel something oddly familiar about you...
(Cutscene plays) (Cutscene ends)
Camellya: My name is Camellya.
Camellya: Try not to let me catch you so easily next time~!
Rover: And she's gone... Huh, that was fast.
Yangyang (Contacting): Rover, what took you so long to pick up the call? Did something happen?
Another stalker showed up.
I met a weird woman.
Yangyang (Contacting): Is that a friend or foe? Are you hurt?
She's from the Black Shores.
Yangyang (Contacting): The Black Shores... Did she tell you anything?
A shame. I let her get away.
I am safe, thank you for asking.
Yangyang (Contacting): Phew... At least you are safe.
How's it going over there?
Yangyang (Contacting): Chixia noticed a guy acting suspicious. I think she's keeping an eye on him.
I'll be there soon.
Yangyang (Contacting): Sure, we are in the shopping district. See you then.
Yangyang: Rover, there you are!
How's it going?
Did they take the bait?
Yangyang: We walked on the streets, wearing the Blake Bloom like you said. Talked to various people, but I didn't hear anything useful...
What did you talk about?
Yangyang: Nothing in particular, just some small talks...
Kind Man: Hey, aren't you the girl from earlier?
Passionate Girl: Yeah! You're so pretty! Can I take another selfie with you? The one we did earlier looked a bit blurry...
Oh, I see.
Understandable. I want a selfie with you too.
Yangyang: P-Please stop teasing me!
How about Chixia?
Yangyang: Chixia did say she found someone suspicious... Look, it's him.
Chixia: Rover, perfect timing! This guy's been sniffin' around here for a while now. He keeps trying to talk to the elderly and minors! I've been keeping an eye on him!
Chixia: And I saw a little girl with him! She kept turning her head looking around, but now she's nowhere to be found. This is super fishy!
Chixia: Hey, I'm Patroller Chixia. Sir, business license, please.
Aalto: B-Business license? Uuuhh... Oh! I'm Aalto, just a humble information broker. I've been travelling around, helping people out in my own small way...
Chixia: I see. So, no license. I bet you don't have a fixed business location either, huh?
Aalto: ...Business location? Why would I need that?
Chixia: Hmph, now show me your Organizational Accreditation, please.
Aalto: Well... I am an honest broker of information, always open to negotiations at the right price! I'm the all-time intel champ, with more Best Seller certificates than I can count...
Chixia: No license, no clear business plan... You're running an illegal business, then...
Aalto: ...
Chixia: Who's your supervisor? You should at least have their ID number?
Aalto: My s-supervisor? Oh right! She's, like, a super big deal!
Aalto: She's an ancient being, born with this planet we're living on. She's the will of the star, the reverberation of everything in this world...
Are you for real?
I'm not buying that.
Chixia: So do you even have a supervisor or not?
Aalto: What? C'mon, I already told you about her! Why won't you believe me?
Chixia: Yeah, yeah! I believe you! I know what's going on!
Chixia: Now, sir, you're coming with me to the Patroller Station!
